news.title: Maracanã to host opening game and final at next year’s Women’s World Cup
news.lede: Stadium has hosted two men’s World Cup finals. Arena Itaquera in São Paulo will host 10 matches. The Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro will host the opening game and the final of next year’s Women’s World Cup. The 78,838-capacity stadium, which hosted the finals of the 1950 and 2014 men’s World Cups as well as the finals of the Olympic football competitions in 2016, will be the venue for Brazil’s opening Group A match on 24 June, before staging the final on 25 July.

news.title: FIFA begins disciplinary proceedings against Hossam Hassan and Zico: Egypt responds
news.lede: Will Egypt face sanctions after the World Cup incidents? FIFA have opened disciplinary proceedings against several members of the Egyptian national team following the events at the 2026 World Cup. Egypt reached the round of 16 for the first time in their history, and the Arab side came within touching distance of the quarter-finals before Argentina's comeback denied them. A narrow 3-2 defeat to Argentina ended their run at the finals held across the United States, Canada and Mexico.

news.title: ‘He must resign’: Fans’ petition calls for Infantino to quit as Fifa president
news.lede: Fans say Infantino has ‘lost the right to lead’. Statement also calls for Fifa to be reformed. Fans’ groups worldwide have launched a petition calling for the resignation of Gianni Infantino as Fifa president and for wholesale reform of the organisation. Infantino is under mounting pressure after being forced to abandon plans to seek private investment to run Fifa tournaments, including the men’s and women’s World Cups.

news.title: Fazili wants 10 friendlies against top nations ahead of World Cup
news.lede: The head coach of Malawi’s Women’s National Football Team has issued a bold demand to the country’s football chiefs – arrange at least 10 international friendly matches against highly-ranked sides before the 2027 Fifa Women’s World Cup. Lovemore Fazili made the call today, urging the Football Association of Malawi (FAM) to step up preparations for the tournament, as the Scorchers were honoured at a special luncheon hosted by First Lady Gertrude Mutharika at Kamuzu Palace in Lilongwe. ‘The friendlies we had mostly when preparing for Wafcon were against neighbouring countries. For the World Cup preparations, we need to play top teams outside the continent,’ Fazili said.

news.title: Can World Cup heroes carry the magic into the Premier League?
news.lede: For Ugandan football fans, the end of the 2026 World Cup does not mean the end of the excitement. Instead, attention now shifts to England, where the Premier League kicks off this Friday, August 21, with supporters wondering how their favourite stars will respond after a demanding month on the international stage. The World Cup ended on July 19, 2026, leaving roughly a month before the domestic season resumes. For fans who followed the tournament closely, that short turnaround has created a mixture of excitement and concern.

news.title: Football: Soccer-Brazil's iconic Maracana to stage Women's World Cup opener and final in 2027
news.lede: Aug 20 (Reuters) - ⁠Brazil will stage the opening game and final of the 2027 ⁠Women's World Cup at Rio de Janeiro's Maracana Stadium, according ‌to the match schedule unveiled on Thursday for the 32-team tournament. The hosts kick off the event on June 24 in a fitting opening to the first Women's World Cup ​held in South America, with the Maracana -- one ⁠of the game's most famous ⁠venues and the site of Brazil's heartbreak defeat by Uruguay in the ⁠1950 ‌men's World Cup decider -- also hosting the July 25 final. FIFA confirmed that all eight host cities will stage at least seven ⁠matches and a minimum of one knockout game. Brasilia, Porto ​Alegre, Recife and ‌Salvador will stage matches through to the last 16, while Belo ⁠Horizonte, Fortaleza, ​Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo will hold the quarter-finals.

news.title: Maracanã To Host 2027 Women’s World Cup Opener, Final As FIFA Unveils Schedule
news.lede: The iconic Estádio do Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro will host both the opening match and final of the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup, after FIFA unveiled the full.
